title: Iteration: first call uses non-ISO currency name and is rejected; must retry with ISO codes
system: You are a precise assistant with access to tools. Call a tool when it is needed; if a tool reports an error or rejects an input, fix the input and retry. After receiving tool results, give a short final answer in English including the converted amount. Never invent values.
user: Convert 1,200 euro to US dollars using the FX rate tool and tell me the result.

function.name: get_fx_rate
function.description: Look up the exchange rate between two currencies and convert an amount. Currency codes must be ISO 4217.

amount.description: Amount in the source currency to convert

failure.error: rejected: unsupported currency code (use ISO 4217, e.g. EUR and USD) or amount missing; retry with corrected codes
